visualCharacteristics: 3-up wrapping grid of text-only white cards with thick navy top border and shadow, title, description, navy arrow
contentPattern: One row per card, one column: H3 title, description paragraph, link to the target page.
usage: Text-only link cards pointing to related pages or business stages, typically 3 per grid.
reuseGuidance: Use when cards have no image. For cards with an image use cards-image-tile.
